ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels with approximately <5% high-intensity white pixel distribution localized to circular scar patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation covering the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white annular blobs (rosettes) are scattered non-uniformly across both the left and right ventral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the distal tips and sweeping downward towards the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active biological colonization visible as orange and brownish-yellow high-contrast clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
